notes.n1: Audi MediaCenter (Wayback) Q3 plug-in hybrid press release: 45 TFSI e = front-wheel drive, 6-speed S tronic (DQ400e), 1.4 TFSI plus 85 kW electric motor, German production start January 2021. The official technical-data sheet gives the forward ratios 3.500 / 2.773 / 1.852 / 1.020 / 1.023 / 0.840 in that order (4th below 5th is how the sheet prints them; the two gears run through different gearbox outputs) and two gearbox output final drives, 4.588 (1-2) and 3.545 (2-3); 3.545 is the one behind the top gear (see the final-drive note) and is the only one stored.
notes.n2: Audi MediaCenter (Wayback) 'Extensive engine range' press release: 35 TDI = 150 PS / 340 Nm / front-wheel drive / 7-speed S tronic (DQ381). The official technical-data sheets (status 03/22/2024 and 06/05/2025) give the forward ratios 3.579 / 2.750 / 1.677 / 0.889 / 0.677 / 0.722 / 0.561 and two gearbox output final drives, 4.813 (1-2) and 3.667 (2-3); 3.667 is the one behind the top gear (see the final-drive note) and is the only one stored.
notes.n3: Audi MediaCenter (Wayback) 'Extensive engine range' press release: 35 TFSI = 150 PS / 250 Nm / front-wheel drive / 7-speed S tronic (DQ381). The official technical-data sheets give the forward ratios 3.190 / 2.750 / 1.897 / 1.040 / 0.793 / 0.860 / 0.661 (5th below 6th as printed; the two gears run through different gearbox outputs) and two gearbox output final drives, 5.200 (1-2) and 3.900 (2-3); 3.900 is the one behind the top gear (see the final-drive note) and is the only one stored.
notes.n5: Audi MediaCenter (Wayback) 'Extensive engine range' press release: 40 TDI = 190 PS / 400 Nm / quattro / 7-speed S tronic (DQ381) with Haldex rear coupling. The official technical-data sheets give top gear 0.561 and two gearbox output final drives, 4.813 (1-2) and 3.667 (2-3); 3.667 is the one behind the top gear (see the final-drive note) and is the only one stored (as final_drive_rear, the AWD convention). The full forward gear set is not stored.
notes.n6: Audi MediaCenter (Wayback) 'Extensive engine range' press release: 40 TFSI = 190 PS / 320 Nm / quattro / 7-speed S tronic (DQ381) with Haldex rear coupling. The official technical-data sheets give top gear 0.635 and two gearbox output final drives, 4.813 (1-2) and 3.667 (2-3); 3.667 is the one behind the top gear (see the final-drive note) and is the only one stored (as final_drive_rear, the AWD convention). The full forward gear set is not stored.

top_gear_ratio.notes: The checked official Audi MediaCenter 2024 and 2025 technical-data PDFs list 0.561 as the 7th-gear ratio for the old-generation Q3 35 TDI S tronic state. Applied as official-derived evidence while year-by-year continuity remains unresolved.

gear_ratios.notes: Forward ratios 3.579 / 2.750 / 1.677 / 0.889 / 0.677 / 0.722 / 0.561 per the official Audi MediaCenter technical-data sheets (Q3 35 TDI S tronic 110 kW, status 03/22/2024 and 06/05/2025).

final_drive_front.notes: The official Audi technical-data sheet (Q3 35 TDI S tronic 110 kW, status 03/22/2024 and 06/05/2025) prints two gearbox output final drives, 4.813 (1-2) and 3.667 (2-3), not separate front and rear axle ratios. Of every way to run the forward ratios 3.579 / 2.750 / 1.677 / 0.889 / 0.677 / 0.722 / 0.561 through the two outputs, only those with the top gear on 3.667 keep the overall ratios falling gear by gear (for example 4th 0.889 x 4.813 = 4.279, 5th 0.677 x 4.813 = 3.258, 6th 0.722 x 3.667 = 2.648, 7th 0.561 x 3.667 = 2.057; 7th on 4.813 would give 2.700), so 3.667 is the final drive behind the top gear and is stored as final_drive_front; 4.813 drives only lower gears and is not stored as an axle ratio. The row previously stored 4.813, the output behind the lower gears.
